study.question: Does removing the radial component of the aggregate auxiliary history-adapter context cotangent improve click AUC beyond the incumbent, and beyond a control with the same local cotangent norm but the original direction? Observed limitation: the adapter-only incumbent reaches0.6670575100016033 versus0.6668051956575413 with that context edge disabled (+0.000252314344062). The latest identity-only and other-only gates reach0.6668144964131157 and0.6666226640621917, respectively: neither recovers the all-field result, with descriptive2x2 interaction0.000425545183837. Cart/fav-only, buy-only and history-length-only gates likewise failed to exceed the incumbent; context benefit cannot yet be localized by those partitions. These are same-seed observations; cotangent directions, norms and optimizer updates have not been measured. Raw data and torch are not exposed in this proposal environment, so host readiness is inherited from the frozen successful receipts, not newly reproduced here.
study.hypothesis: The useful joint context signal may reside preferentially in directional changes of existing context embeddings, while radial components contribute interference. Filtering only the summed auxiliary adapter-to-context cotangent onto the per-field tangent plane may retain all task/field coverage and improve click ranking without extra learned capacity. A norm-matched original-direction control distinguishes directional filtering from simple attenuation. This is provisional and motivated by local localization failures, not by observed scale invariance. Past failures remain evidence: naive compressed task routing underperformed event routing (0.6591942389399411 vs0.660163362657485), and ordered cubic detail underperformed its gated duplicate (0.665704885611003 vs0.6659300360390669). More structure is not automatically useful.

Primary equation10 supplies the established radial/tangent projection. AdamP conditionally projects preconditioned momentum updates of scale-invariant parameters. Here project the aggregate auxiliary adapter activation cotangent before sparse table aggregation and the unchanged Adagrad step, without a scale-invariance detector or momentum alteration. Add a same-local-norm original-direction replacement control. No novelty, AdamP equivalence or transfer of its convergence/performance results is claimed.

PCGrad compares separate task parameter gradients and projects conflicts against other task gradients. This proposal neither computes those conflicts nor changes host gradient handling: its reference direction is each existing context embedding, and only one summed auxiliary activation edge is modified. Gradient-projection terminology and possible interference are inherited ideas, not a priority claim.

Original method sections accessed directly after the registry disclosed unavailable detailed text. INFNet uses categorical/sequence/task tokens with proxy cross attention and within-type gated units. This suite retains the local compressed task adapters and changes one backward edge; it does not add proxy interactions or reproduce INFNet.

study.proposed_difference: Insert one shared identity-forward autograd node on aux_context used ONLY by cart/fav/buy history adapters during training; the click and direct tower paths retain the original context. After all three auxiliary contributions sum, reshape each row into inherited context fields of width16. Let x be that field embedding and g its summed cotangent. For ||x||^2>1e-12 set u=x/||x||; otherwise u=0. Define r=u(u dot g), t=g-r. Tangent candidate returns t. Norm-matched control returns g*sqrt(||t||^2/max(||g||^2,1e-30)). For ||g||^2<=1e-30 both return g. Both partial modes compute both results in FP32 with autocast disabled, then select and cast back. This equalizes local gradient norm up to FP32 and output-dtype rounding while changing direction. Full/blocked controls return context/context.detach directly and avoid any custom backward. Eval bypasses all interventions. No new parameter, buffer, random draw, label access, external I/O, loss term or host optimizer change. This replacement suite is not a radial/tangent factorial; radial-only effectiveness is left untested. The only allowed outputs written are proposal.json and four standalone model modules. Observation/revision provenance is carried in this study and variant notes for host ingestion; no human-owned or receipt archive is modified.

falsifiers: Tangent fails to exceed the full bridge: removing the radial component has not improved this implementation, even if it remains above blocked. A failure is not a general refutation of directional sharing.

Tangent fails to exceed the norm-matched original-direction control: directional filtering lacks support beyond attenuation at the tested local norm. If both beat full, prefer an attenuation explanation pending further controls.

Norm-matched wins and tangent loses, or full wins both: directional information removed by projection may be useful, or the embedding reference may be inappropriate. Do not reinterpret that outcome as a new successful mechanism.

Changed fixed-state probabilities/buffers, click gradients, learned counts, source ownership, invalid sparse backward, nonfinite BF16 tensors, or checkpoint parity failures invalidate the comparison pending repair. All failed checks/jobs remain charged.
Local norm matching does not hold under host analytic VJP checks, or the guarded population dominates: the declared replacement contrast is not implemented reliably.

Any apparent advantage disappears under admissible paired seed repetitions/user-cluster bootstrap or is dominated in measured cost: retain preliminary/null status. Repeated same-seed bridges provide no independent evidence.
